title: Common providers: Croatia
coverage: Partial. Complete for the three national operators (fixed and mobile), the state transmission network and the research network; cable and fibre operators and business ISPs are thin, and the regulator's register was not read as a list.
missing: Smaller business ISPs and local cable operators
Cable and fibre operators other than the national operators (the regulator's register is in Croatian and its terms were not read, so no name was taken from it)

sources.name: HAKOM (Croatian Regulatory Authority for Network Industries): e-register of operators
sources.terms: The page was requested on the read date; its reuse terms were not read (they are in the national language), so nothing is copied.
sources.result: The page answered on the read date. It is the authority to consult for operators this pack lacks.

sources.name: Wikipedia: Telecommunications in Croatia
sources.terms: CC BY-SA 4.0. Used to cross-check names only (facts); no text is copied.
sources.result: 4 of 6 entries were found on the page, by their name or a distinctive other name.

sources.name: Wikipedia: Internet in Croatia
sources.terms: CC BY-SA 4.0. Used to cross-check names only (facts); no text is copied.
sources.result: 5 of 6 entries were found on the page, by their name or a distinctive other name.

sources.name: Each provider's own public website
sources.terms: Only the address itself is recorded (a fact); no content is copied.
sources.result: 6 of 6 websites answered an automated check; an address that did not answer is left empty. No support or status page was checked.

sources.name: RIPEstat as-overview (RIPE NCC)
sources.terms: The RIPEstat terms forbid redistributing RIPEstat data: nothing is copied. Consulted to confirm, for each AS number, that the registered holder is the named provider.
sources.result: 10 AS numbers confirmed, each announced on the read date; a number whose holder was another company is listed only where the note says whose it is.

sources.name: RIPE Database (RIPE NCC): organisation and aut-num objects
sources.terms: The RIPE Database terms were not re-read for this pack; it is treated like RIPEstat data: nothing is copied. Consulted to find which AS numbers an organisation holds.
sources.result: Read to find candidate AS numbers; each was then confirmed as above.

sources.name: NRO delegated statistics (the regional registries' joint list of assigned AS numbers)
sources.terms: Published by the registries for public use; only which registry holds each AS number is taken (a fact).
sources.result: Every AS number in the pack was found in the list; its registry is recorded beside it.

sources.name: Wikipedia: Hrvatski Telekom; A1 Hrvatska
sources.terms: CC BY-SA 4.0. Cited for names and dates (facts); no text is copied.
sources.result: Read on the date above for former names: T-Com and Iskon (Hrvatski Telekom), Vipnet and Metronet (A1 Hrvatska).
